summary.text: Chris Welch has represented the 7th District in the Illinois House since January 2013, and the legislature lists him as Speaker of the House.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, Welch is an attorney with a B.A. from Northwestern University and a J.D. from John Marshall Law School.
Welch is a former member and president of the Proviso Township High Schools District 209 Board of Education.
